_comment: Market-value providers. A provider is used only when enabled, its token env var is set, and mappingVerified is true. PriceCharting/SportsCardsPro documented basics: token in 't', /api/product?id=, /api/products?q=. The grade→field mapping, name fields and price unit were NOT confirmed from the official docs (not reachable when this was written): confirm them with Admin → Market → 'Check mapping' against a live response before setting mappingVerified to true.
